title: linear.v1 weights
description: Gym-cli LinearPolicyAi pack (not Hall). Score is bias + direct actionFeat weights + packed[i]*actionFeat[i mod 23]*W[i] (and the same pairing for each bag-hash slot). Greedy argmax. Zeros W is a legal stub and still triggers the gym anti-stall prior. Do not distill W from YodaBot/AdvancedAi. Training loop is not this file.

actionFeatDim.description: 0 pass, 1 integerNorm, 2 indexNorm, 3-18 text hash, 19-22 blueprint hash, 23 ones, 24-49 action-keyword kinds, 50-70 choice-table kinds, then grounded card type/subtype/category/side and state facts. Matches com.gempukku.swccgo.ai.models.LinearPolicyAi.ACTION_FEAT_DIM. Not one weight per card name.

W.description: Length must be packedDim + bagHashDim + actionFeatDim (438 when bagHashDim is 0, 454 when bagHashDim is 16, 502 when bagHashDim is 64). Prefix slots are state×action interactions. New packed slots are inserted after the original 128 and before the bag-hash weights, zero until trained. The last actionFeatDim entries are direct action weights. Not one weight per card name.
